remarks: Direct Waterfront Luxury in Gated Charles Cove - Private 46' Dock  Experience the luxury of life on the water, in an exclusive, amenity-rich retreat. This 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhome sits directly on the water in Charles Cove, one of the area's most coveted gated communities-complete with a private pool, scenic boardwalk, and tennis courts. With your own 46-foot deep-water dock just steps from your deck, you'll enjoy effortless access to Long Island Sound and the serenity of Charles Creek, right outside your door.  Inside, a sun-filled, open-concept main level is designed for both relaxed living and unforgettable entertaining. The gourmet kitchen, spacious dining area, and inviting family room with a wood-burning fireplace flow seamlessly to a waterfront deck-perfect for morning coffee, evening cocktails, or prime views of the 4th of July fireworks.  Upstairs, the primary suite feels like a private retreat with its own deck overlooking the marina, spa-like en-suite bath with soaking tub and walk-in shower, and the unbeatable luxury of waking up to your boat just outside your balcony. Two additional bedrooms, a second full bath, and another deck complete this level.  The third floor offers a versatile bonus space-ideal for a home office, guest room, gym, or media lounge-with generous storage and privacy. Additional perks include in-unit laundry, an attached garage, and ample guest parking.
